composting.card: We turn organic fractions into quality compost that returns nutrients to the soil and keeps material out of landfill.
composting.lead: We turn the organic fractions of beer production into stable compost that returns organic matter and nutrients to the soil.

blocks.p: Biological sludge, malt residues and other organic fractions undergo controlled composting, with temperature, moisture and aeration monitored at every stage.
Each batch is tracked until fully mature, producing a uniform and safe compost for crops, pastures and land restoration.
Composting keeps organic matter out of landfill, cuts the emissions linked to disposal and strengthens regional agriculture.

A closed loop with local farmers

feed.card: Treated spent grain becomes a nutritious, cost competitive feed for beef and dairy herds.
feed.h1: Animal nutrition with brewers' spent grain
feed.lead: Spent grain treated by Eco4 is a protein and fibre rich feed that helps ranchers keep productive herds at a competitive cost.

blocks.p: Spent grain is rich in protein, digestible fibre and energy, and is widely used in beef and dairy cattle diets alongside forage and concentrate.
Our process stabilises the grain right after collection, preserving its quality for longer and enabling regular deliveries even to remote farms.
Planned logistics ensure steady supply, with technical guidance on storage and on including spent grain in the herd's diet.

points: Source of protein and fibre for beef and dairy cattle
Competitive cost compared with other inputs
Stabilised product with longer shelf life
Technical guidance on use and storage

tech.name: Technology & Innovation
tech.card: Proprietary technology that stabilises, preserves and converts waste into marketable products.
tech.lead: A proprietary solution refined over decades that stabilises, preserves and converts brewing industry waste into marketable products.

blocks.p: Our technology grew out of daily operations with major breweries. It controls the variables that degrade the waste, such as moisture, temperature and microbial activity, and prepares each fraction for the right destination.
Volumes, timing and destinations are logged per batch. This data feeds the impact reports we deliver to clients and drives continuous process improvement.
We invest in new applications for brewing by-products, widening the routes to value and reducing disposal even further.

points: Longer shelf life for treated spent grain
Highest value destination for each fraction
Lower disposal costs for the brewery

about.lead: For {years} years, Eco 4 Solutions has turned brewing industry waste into resources for agriculture and industry.
history: Eco 4 Solutions began with a simple question: why should a by-product as nutritious as spent grain end up as waste? The answer became a business model built on circular economy principles long before the term was widely used.

Over nearly four decades we have grown alongside the leading breweries in Brazil and Paraguay, developed our own treatment technology and expanded into managing every waste stream generated at the plant.

timeline.p: The company is born with a pioneering idea: give brewery spent grain a useful destination.
Operations grow alongside the leading breweries in southeastern Brazil.
We develop the process that stabilises and preserves spent grain, extending shelf life and delivery range for ranchers.
We open the Villeta office to serve the country's breweries to the same operating standard.
We take on every waste stream at the plant and deliver environmental indicators for sustainability reporting.
We serve major brewing groups in both countries and keep investing in new products.

about.mission: To turn brewing industry waste into resources for agriculture and industry, with technology, safety and measurable environmental results.
about.vision: To be the benchmark in circular economy for the beverage industry in South America.

bagaco-na-dieta-do-gado.title: Spent grain in cattle diets: what to consider
bagaco-na-dieta-do-gado.excerpt: Why brewers' spent grain has become an ally of livestock farming and how to keep its quality from storage to feed bunk.
body: Spent grain is rich in protein and digestible fibre, making it an efficient supplement in beef and dairy cattle diets. As a wet product, its quality depends directly on how it is treated and preserved after leaving the brewery.
With Eco4 stabilisation, spent grain keeps its properties for longer, giving ranchers more flexibility in storage and diet formulation.
We always recommend working with an animal nutritionist or veterinarian to set the right inclusion rate for each group in the herd.

indicadores-de-economia-circular.title: Circular economy at the brewery: the indicators that matter
indicadores-de-economia-circular.excerpt: Which numbers truly show the environmental impact of waste management, and how to bring them into your ESG report.
body: Reuse rate, volume diverted from landfill and final destination by fraction are the indicators most requested by sustainability teams and auditors.
At Eco4, every load is logged from the plant gate to its destination. This record makes it possible to consolidate periodic reports with verifiable data, ready for the annual sustainability report.

operacao-no-paraguai.title: One operation, two countries: how we serve Paraguay
operacao-no-paraguai.excerpt: From Villeta, we bring Paraguay the same management and traceability standard we apply in Brazil.
body: Our Villeta office, in the Central Department, coordinates waste management for Paraguayan breweries using the same methodology as in Brazil.
This integrated operation gives groups with plants in both countries comparable indicators and a single quality standard.

p: Eco 4 Solutions, with offices in Brazil and Paraguay, is the controller of the personal data collected on this website. This policy follows Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018, LGPD) and Paraguayan personal data protection law.
Through the contact form: name, company, job title, country, email, phone, area of interest and message. We do not collect sensitive data.
This website does not use tracking or advertising cookies. We only store your language and theme preference in your browser, which does not identify you.
We use the data solely to respond to your request and, where relevant, to prepare commercial proposals. The legal basis is your consent and pre-contractual steps taken at your request.
Data may be shared between our Brazil and Paraguay offices to handle your request, and with the website hosting provider, which processes form submissions. We do not sell personal data.
We keep data only as long as needed to handle the request and meet legal obligations. After that it is deleted or anonymised.

You may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymisation, portability or deletion of your data and withdraw consent at any time. You may also lodge a complaint with the ANPD in Brazil or the competent authority in Paraguay.
To exercise your rights or ask questions, email contato@eco4solutions.com (Brazil) or oficina.py@eco4solutions.com (Paraguay).
